dashboard.label: GSPC evidence
dashboard.description: GSPC evidence events in this Splunk, and the live GSPC evidence panel for the subject you pick. The panel reads councilof.ai only. Evidence by GSPC · Council of AI. Measurement, not certification.

input.label: Subject (MCP server URL, agent card URL, model id, card id or claim id)

panel.title: GSPC evidence events (OCSF and ECS) — click a row to open its subject in the panel

search.query: sourcetype IN ("csoai:evidence:ecs","csoai:evidence:ocsf") | eval gspc_subject=coalesce(gspc_subject, 'csoai.subject.locator', 'resources{}.uid'), gspc_state=coalesce(gspc_state, 'csoai.state', 'unmapped.csoai.state') | stats latest(_time) AS last_seen count BY gspc_subject gspc_state sourcetype | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort - last_seen
